extracted.intended_audience: poets, translators, and writers submitting work to Poetry magazine / Poetry Foundation
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and requirements for submitting poems, prose, visual poetry, and letters to Poetry magazine via its online submission system. Covers eligibility, file formats, length limits, rights/payment, response times, and letter-to-editor policies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope / selection standard
rubrics_metrics.description: We examine all work received and accept that which seems best. We consider original works written in the English language as well as translations of poetry into English.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The magazine cannot provide individual criticism due to volume and small staff. Anyone contemplating a submission is encouraged to examine the magazine before sending a manuscript.

rubrics_metrics.name: No previously published material
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry cannot consider anything that has been previously published or accepted for publication, anywhere, in any form.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work that has appeared online is considered to have been previously published and should not be submitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment rates and rights
rubrics_metrics.description: Payment is made on publication at the rate of $10 per line (with a minimum payment of $300), and $150 per page of prose, for first serial rights.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All rights will revert to the author upon publication. Authors will also receive two contributor copies of the issue in which their work appears.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission method (online only)
rubrics_metrics.description: As of July 2013, Poetry no longer accepts paper submissions and requires submissions through their online system (poetry.submittable.com).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Your Submittable account will be set up during your first submission; there is no need to create an account beforehand. After submitting, you can check status by signing into your Submittable account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted file types (poetry)
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the 'Poetry' category, submit files in one of the following formats only: Word document (.doc), Rich Text Format (.rtf), Text (.txt), Portable Document Format (.pdf), Word Perfect (.ppf).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poems should be submitted in a single file, with poems separated by titles or page breaks. Include all writer contact info on the first page of the submitted file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual Poetry file types / category
rubrics_metrics.description: There is a 'Visual Poetry' category which accepts JPEG, TIFF, PNG, PDF, and Word document files.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit visual poetry to that category using the listed image/document formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission length and quantity limits
rubrics_metrics.description: Submissions are limited to four poems (one file) and should not exceed ten pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhering to the single submission of four poems or fewer at a time will help ensure a timely response to your work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-submission policy / timing for resubmission
rubrics_metrics.description: Do not make multiple submissions: please wait for a response to your submission before sending new work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Following the single-submission rule helps the editors manage response time. The magazine accepts submissions year round.

rubrics_metrics.name: Response time expectations
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry will do its best to respond within seven months from the day of receipt, but may be slower at times.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The goal is to make sure each submission gets a good read. Adhering to the submission limits helps insure a timely response. Ensure your e-mail spam filter allows mail from poetryfoundation.org and poetrymagazine.org so notifications are not marked as junk.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submittable technical support contact
rubrics_metrics.description: If you have trouble using the online system, contact Submittable by e-mail (support@submittable.com) or by phone: 855.467.8264.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these contacts for technical issues with the submission platform rather than contacting the magazine about system problems.

rubrics_metrics.name: Include contact information on manuscript
rubrics_metrics.description: Please include all writer contact info on the first page of the submitted file.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This ensures the editors can contact you regarding your submission and helps with processing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advice to read the magazine before submitting
rubrics_metrics.description: Anyone contemplating a submission is encouraged to examine the magazine before sending a manuscript.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Subscribe or order a single copy to familiarize yourself with the magazine's content and standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Letters to the Editor: desired content and process
rubrics_metrics.description: Poetry is looking for thought-provoking responses to work published in the magazine, as well as letters that raise new questions about the state of contemporary poetry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submit letters via the online form. If Poetry chooses to use your letter, they will notify you by phone. If you have not heard within two weeks of sending your letter, assume it will not be used. All letters may be edited for length and clarity, and may appear online, in print, or both.
